verdict.rationale: Attio's own pricing page lists "Automatic data enrichment" as a plan feature, and its data page says prospect context is "automatically drawn" and company records carry standard attributes like Industry. A Web Agent workflow can also "Enrich the record with web research." These are marketing bullets only, with no documentation of what enrichment covers. missing for 10: documentation of which firmographic and contact fields are enriched for people and companies, enrichment sources and triggers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
